name: Miyabi Kurou
source:
An eccentric chauvinist who is instructed by his weird business agent to assist talent agency Green Chrome with stopping an idol uprising at their firm. Kurou, well known for his unconventional methods, embraces the task with gusto.

[from [url=http://www.somethingawful.com/d/hentai-game-reviews/idols-galore.php]Something Awful[/url]]
